instruction: Create a characterization test pinning the Day half of CT-2. Day's commitTimedResizeInteraction is GATED on hasMoved: `event: hasMoved ? timedResizeVisualToDayGridEvent(...) : target.event`. On a no-op resize it must return target.event BY REFERENCE IDENTITY - assert with toBe(target.event). This is the exact asymmetry against Week (which maps unconditionally), and asserting by identity is what makes it impossible to 'tidy away'. Also pin that Day's commitAllDayResizeInteraction returns target.event by identity when hasMoved is false. Must pass against UNMODIFIED HEAD.
